basics.name: Danil Shubin
basics.label: Senior Backend Developer (Java / Kotlin / Spring Boot) · AI Agents & System Design
basics.summary: Senior Backend Developer with 9+ years in IT, including 4+ years designing, building, and scaling high-throughput distributed systems in Java, Kotlin, and Spring Boot for a top-tier bank. Strong in system design: microservices, event-driven architecture, DDD, Clean/Hexagonal architecture, resilience and consistency patterns (Saga, Transactional Outbox, idempotency, Circuit Breaker). Early adopter of AI-native engineering: builds AI agents and LLM-powered bots, custom MCP servers, skills and agentic workflows (Claude Code, OpenCode, open-source models) that cut delivery time across the team. Hands-on with legacy decommissioning, cloud-native runtimes, CI/CD, observability, and production incident management.

work.name: Raiffeisen Bank Russia
highlights: Designed, developed, and maintained 10+ mission-critical microservices (payments, forex, payroll) using Kotlin (incl. Coroutines), Java, and Spring Boot for SME banking serving thousands of active daily users

Owned system design end-to-end: gathered requirements, wrote technical design documents and ADRs, defined OpenAPI-first REST and gRPC contracts, data models and SLAs, and drove designs through architecture review

Applied DDD (bounded contexts, aggregates), Clean/Hexagonal architecture and SOLID; used GoF patterns (Strategy, Chain of Responsibility, Builder, Factory, Template Method, Observer) to keep business logic framework-independent and testable

Built reliable distributed workflows with Saga orchestration, Transactional Outbox, idempotent consumers, retries with backoff, dead-letter queues, and exactly-once-effect processing for money-moving operations

Implemented resilience patterns (Circuit Breaker, Retry, Bulkhead, Rate Limiting, timeouts) with Resilience4j and Redis-based caching, keeping services stable under partner-API degradation and peak load

Successfully led the complex decommissioning of legacy CRM systems, architecting and implementing new high-performance substitute services from scratch (Strangler Fig, Anti-Corruption Layer) without business interruption
Architected asynchronous, event-driven data flows using Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, and Apache Avro with a schema registry for strongly-typed, backward-compatible event contracts
Re-engineered database persistence layers leveraging jOOQ, MapStruct, and SQL optimization (indexes, query plans, pagination); integrated Flyway alongside Liquibase for seamless migration versioning

Built AI agents and LLM-powered bots for engineering workflows: custom MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers exposing internal tools, agent skills and plugins for Claude Code and OpenCode, and multi-step agentic pipelines for code generation, code review, test generation, and documentation

Integrated LLMs into backend services via OpenAI-compatible APIs and self-hosted open-source models (Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM) using tool/function calling and RAG over internal docs; evaluated and benchmarked models for cost, latency, and quality
Boosted personal and team delivery speed by rolling out AI-assisted engineering practices: prompt-skills library, agent playbooks, and guardrails for secure use of LLMs with confidential banking data

Explored cloud-native innovations by driving a PoC initiative leveraging GraalVM Native Images to optimize container cold-start efficiency within microservices; managed services configuration via Spring Cloud
Transitioned legacy modules to reactive programming with Spring WebFlux and R2DBC, significantly increasing application throughput
Secured APIs with Spring Security, OAuth2/OIDC and JWT via Keycloak; implemented role-based access control and audit logging

Optimized enterprise CI/CD pipelines using Maven, Gradle, and GitHub Actions within GitLab, incorporating automated static code analysis via SonarQube; cut deployment time by ~60% and introduced canary deployments
Boosted codebase reliability by increasing unit and integration test coverage (JUnit, Mockito, Mockk, Testcontainers, WireMock) to 80%+, resulting in a ~35% drop in production incidents
Troubleshooting and resolving complex production incidents utilizing Prometheus, Grafana, and Kibana for root cause analysis (RCA); defined SLIs/SLOs, alerting rules and dashboards
Mentored developers and QA engineers, ran code reviews and design sessions, and set team-wide coding standards
